subject: MAP: SOC 2 package delivery & security review - next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Ng <samantha@aurelia-tech.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 26 Jun 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: MAP: SOC 2 package delivery & security review - next steps

Hi Samantha —

Great to chat this morning. Per our discovery, I’ve drafted the Mutual Action Plan (attached) and listed the SOC 2 / security review milestone items we agreed on. Below is a concise recap and proposed owners/due dates so we can keep the security review on the critical path for a July close. Please confirm or edit inline.

MAP milestone: Security review & SOC 2 package delivery
- Goal: Provide Aurelia Tech with SOC 2 questionnaire, evidence index, and access to artifacts so security can complete initial review
- Redwood owner: Marissa Cole (Sales Engineering) — provide package + follow up
- Aurelia owner: Samantha Ng (Security Lead) — confirm acceptance window and evidence requests
- Target milestone date: 2026-07-10 (initial review complete)
- Dependencies: NDA executed, Provisioning of read-only S3 access for logs (if requested), SOC 2 report excerpt (if available), and any additional evidence items listed below

Deliverables (we attached the files):
1) redwood_soc2_questionnaire.pdf — completed SOC 2 questionnaire (answers + notes)
2) evidence_index.xlsx — list of evidence artifacts with brief descriptions and approximate retrieval times
3) map-draft-v1.docx — MAP with milestones, responsibilities, and high-level timeline

Outstanding items / asks for Aurelia Tech:
- Confirm if your team needs read-only access to a log store (S3) for a sample week of logs — ETA needed by 2026-06-30
- Flag any proof-of-controls you need prioritized (e.g., encryption keys, MFA screenshots, audit log extracts)
- Share preferred format for evidence (PDF, CSV, screenshots) and any internal ticketing references

Next steps I propose:
- You confirm the MAP and any edits by 2026-06-29 so we can finalize and route to Legal for the small NDA addendum (if needed)
- Redwood delivers any additional screenshots or evidence by 2026-07-02
- Internal checkpoint call (optional) w/security engineers week of 2026-07-06 if deeper dives are required

Thanks — attaching the package now. Happy to jump on a 30-min review call if helpful.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0199

Attachments: redwood_soc2_questionnaire.pdf, evidence_index.xlsx, map-draft-v1.docx

From: Samantha Ng <samantha@aurelia-tech.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Aurelia Tech Security <security@aurelia-tech.com>
Date: Mon, 29 Jun 2026 08:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: MAP: SOC 2 package delivery & security review - next steps

Thanks Marissa — appreciate the quick turnaround and the clear MAP. A few notes from our side after a quick skim: 

1) Thanks for the questionnaire and evidence index. We'll triage internally and get back with a prioritized list by Tue 2026-06-30.
2) Read-only S3 access: yes, that would be helpful. Our preference is a 7-day sample with IAM role-based access. Can you provide an estimated delivery ETA for that?
3) Preferred formats: PDF for screenshots/config, CSV for logs, and signed PDFs for policy documents.

One clarification on the target milestone: is 2026-07-10 intended to be "initial review complete" or "final sign-off"? We expect initial review by that date, with final items (if any) resolved after.

Also looping in our security manager (cc'd) who will own the internal review scheduling.

If possible, we'd like to schedule a technical call with one of your security engineers on Wed 2026-07-07 (morning PST) to walk through the evidence index. Does that work?

Best,
Samantha Ng
Security Lead | Aurelia Tech
samantha@aurelia-tech.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Ng <samantha@aurelia-tech.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 29 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP: SOC 2 package delivery & security review - next steps

Hi Samantha —

Thanks — all good notes. To confirm: 2026-07-10 = initial review complete (we'll aim for final sign-off by 2026-07-20 assuming no major gaps).

S3 access ETA: We can provision a read-only role and share details by 2026-07-01 EOD. If Aurelia needs earlier access for immediate testing, we can prioritize to 2026-06-30 — let us know.

We can do the tech call Wed 2026-07-07 at 10:00 AM PST. I'll have one of our security engineers (Aditya) on the call to walk the evidence_index and answer deeper control questions.

Action items updated: 
- Marissa: finalize and send S3 role + any screenshots by 2026-07-01 (or 2026-06-30 if Aurelia requests)
- Aditya: standby to join 2026-07-07 technical call and prepare notes on key control proofs
- Samantha: confirm preferred call time and the priority list by 2026-06-30

I'll update the MAP doc (attached v1) with these dates and owners and send final version after we confirm the call time.

Best,
Marissa
